name: Personyze WordPress Plugin
author: Personyze

sections.description:
Personyze combines artificial intelligence and powerful targeting to provide each visitor with a personalized, tailored experience that will keep them engaged, converting, and returning for more. This page will give you a summary of our personalization engine from top to bottom.

Personyze plugin for WordPress allows you to deeply integrate your WordPress content into Personyze personalization tools that include targeting and site AI based recommendation to deliver each visitor a personal experience.

For instructions please visit https://wiki.personyze.com/knowledgebase/wordpress-personalization-plugin/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Open the plugin settings and enter your site name and API key from your Personyze account.
  3. Save. Your WordPress content is now available to Personyze targeting and recommendations, and WordPress short codes are substituted inside Personyze actions.
